title: EEG — ERPs and time-frequency analysis with EEGLAB and FieldTrip
description: Portfolio scaffold for EEG preprocessing, event-related potentials, time-frequency analysis, and cluster-based permutation testing using EEGLAB and FieldTrip with a Sternberg-task workflow. The repository describes a planned analysis and does not claim completed results.
notes: Portfolio scaffold. The archived repository documents a planned workflow and does not claim completed scientific results.
